:::{#def-pearson-r}
#### Pearson correlation coefficient

The **Pearson correlation coefficient** of $n$ paired observations
$(x_1, y_1), \ldots, (x_n, y_n)$ is:

$$r \eqdef \frac{\sumin (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)(\outvar_\iobs - \outbar)}
{\sqrt{\sumin (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)^2} \sqrt{\sumin (\outvar_\iobs - \outbar)^2}}$$

It is defined when neither variable is constant,
so that both sums of squares are positive.
:::
